sheet.p: Before you start: a Jobiba employer account with a confirmed company email, and its account owner at hand. In Jobiba, the owner switches the connection on first (Employer dashboard, Integrations, "Connect my hiring system"). The Free plan holds 3 open jobs through this connection. This Odoo server must reach jobiba.com over HTTPS.

ol.li:
API key. Open , create a key and paste it here.
A key is already saved. Leave the field empty to keep it, or paste a new key to replace it.

Applications from Jobiba (optional now, can be added later). In Jobiba, open , add this address and choose the application events:
Jobiba then shows a signing secret. Paste it here, save, and press "Send a test" in Jobiba.
Save and test. Odoo checks the key against Jobiba without creating anything.

p.strong: What this Odoo database sends to jobiba.com

ul.li: The API key, with every request.

For each job position you publish: a reference made of this database's ID, the company ID and the job ID; the title; the location; the description; and, when you filled them in, the application link, the pay with its currency and period, job type, work mode and experience level. "Preview and publish" on a job shows the exact data first.
The references of jobs you sent (to read their state or to close them) and the Jobiba numbers of applications Odoo already holds (to ask where they stand).

div.p: No applicant, employee or other record of this database is sent. Odoo reads from Jobiba your plan, the state of your jobs and your own applications (contact details, answers and CVs only on a paid Jobiba plan with applicant details switched on in Jobiba). Privacy policy: jobiba.com/privacy

sheet.p: The key and the secret are stored on the Odoo server and are never sent back to a browser or written to a log. Odoo database administrators can read stored values; to keep the key out of the database, set jobiba_api_key_<connection id> in odoo.conf instead.
